sloka: अश्वानाम् खादनेन अहम् अर्थी न अन्येन केनचित् ।एतावता अत्र भवता भविष्यामि सुपूजितः ॥२-५०-४५॥
transliteration: aśvānām khādanena aham arthī na anyena kenacit ।etāvatā atra bhavatā bhaviṣyāmi supūjitaḥ ॥2-50-45॥

translations.english: "I have need of fodder for the horses and of nothing else at all; by this much alone shall I be well honoured by you."
